breakdown.description: The setup describes a vertical bubble column with gas injected to rise along the Y-axis, but gravity is applied horizontally, which would push the bubbles sideways instead of upwards.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The specification describes a vertical column with height in the Y-direction and gas injected upwards along the Y-axis (`U.air set to fixedValue (0 0.1 0)`). However, it incorrectly applies gravity horizontally along the negative X-axis (`g (-9.81 0 0)`). For the bubbles to rise vertically against gravity, the gravity vector should have been corrected to `(0 -9.81 0)`.
